in_greek.name: Χαρλη
in_greek.long_meaning: A name derived from the Greek word χαρα, meaning joy, and λη, meaning people or body. It can be interpreted as ‘joyful people’ or ‘joyful one’.

in_latin.name: Harleius
in_latin.long_meaning: A Latin name derived from the word ‘harle,’ meaning mountain, and ‘ius,’ meaning man or right. It can be interpreted as ‘mountain man’ or ‘rock man.’
